title: Garden and Songbook
author: Cyrus Zhou
blurb: Paloma Dravenmoor, a marine biologist counting turtles instead of heartbreaks, has spent fifteen years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
